mechanism: Eplerenone is a potassium-sparing aldosterone antagonist that increases serum potassium, and concurrent magnesium supplementation may potentiate hyperkalemia and hypermagnesemia risks, particularly in patients with renal impairment.
action: Monitor serum potassium and magnesium levels regularly; use magnesium supplementation cautiously and only when clinically indicated; counsel patients to avoid excessive magnesium intake.
